notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ When using his Ultimate, inflicts "Besotted" on all enemies for 2 turns, enhances his Basic ATK and advances his action by 100%. Any SPD debuff will affect the 100% Action Advance.

✦ Enemies in the "Besotted" state will receive more Break DMG and allies attacking enemies them will receive healing. His Enhanced Basic ATK decreases the enemy target’s ATK while providing healing to all allies.

**Noteable Investments**

**E4 > E2**

**Investment Explanation**

✦ E4 significantly makes his sustain and Ultimate rotation more comfortable.

✦ E2 provides him with more utility, and makes him slightly more viable against enemies with debuffs.

**Ability Rotation**

Basic ATK spam, Skill if needed
